title: Barbara Hutton’s Rolls-Royce survived a prince’s fatal crash and sold for £166,750 in 2026
summary_full: This remarkable 1933 Rolls-Royce Phantom II Continental was originally crafted as a luxurious present from Barbara Hutton to Prince Alexis Mdivani. Following a tragic accident that claimed the prince's life, the exquisite vehicle was returned to Hutton for repairs. It changed hands multiple times before making its way to the United States in the 1970s.
